For that employee, their salary will be multiplied by x$$$x$$$. Also, for all subordinates of u$$$u$$$ their salary will be multiplied by x$$$x$$$ as well.

An employee is happy at some year if their salary was divisible by k$$$k$$$ in that year. If one employee was happy initially print 0$$$0$$$ and if they were never happy print −1$$$-1$$$.
